nodes.description: Owned.owner storage address; the privileged owner of every migratable contract.
BaseMigration.deployer, set to msg.sender at construction; gates the migrate() entrypoint.
Publicly callable helper that performs abi-encoded low-level calls on an arbitrary contract to nominate its owner.
onlyDeployer migration entrypoint that accepts ownership of 8 legacy contracts and rewires the protocol.
Iterates the caller vesting schedule, compares entries against now, mutates escrow balances and transfers SNX out.
Authority-gated loop that transfers SNX to configured destinations and performs an unchecked low-level notifyRewardAmount call on each.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, deployer, onlyFeePool and authority checks.
Block time (now) used to compute vesting unlock times and to decide which escrow entries are claimable.
Low-level .call() on a caller-supplied forContract with a nominateNewOwner/nominateOwner payload - arbitrary external invocation.
Low-level .call() to each reward destination inside distributeRewards; return value ignored, external code runs mid-loop.
Adds a vesting entry, increments totalEscrowedBalance and derives the unlock time from now + 52 weeks.
Global escrowed SNX accounting variable mutated before and after external SNX transfers.
Payable fallback that pushes msg.sender into the target and forwards calldata/value via assembly call.
Assembly-level call() forwarding all calldata and callvalue to the stored target without a success allowlist.
abi.encodeWithSignature payload built inside returnOwnership and passed to the low-level call.
Boolean result of the low-level call in returnOwnership; only checked to decide a fallback attempt.
Caller-supplied target address for the low-level nomination call in returnOwnership.
Address passed to migrate() and compared against the stored owner before re-assigning ownership.
onlyFeePool-guarded external wrapper that delegates to _appendVestingEntry.
Accumulated vested quantity in vest() that is subtracted from escrow accounting before the transfer.
onlyOwner function that sets suspend/resume rights on a whitelisted section for an arbitrary account.

edges.reason: migrate() is guarded by onlyDeployer, which requires msg.sender == deployer; the caller controls this gate.
The unvalidated forContract parameter is the target of the low-level .call(), letting an arbitrary address execute code in this context.
The abi-encoded payload built from owner flows directly into the low-level call calldata.
The success flag is consumed after the arbitrary external call, so failure handling depends on attacker-controlled code.
returnOwnership is unauthenticated and reaches the low-level call directly from any EOA.
Proxy fallback writes msg.sender into the target before forwarding the call, so the caller fully controls downstream execution.
The fallback unconditionally performs an assembly call() forwarding calldata and callvalue to the target.
vest() reads the caller's own vesting schedule keyed by msg.sender.
Timestamp dependency: vest() decides claimability by comparing schedule times against now, so miners can influence which entries vest.
_appendVestingEntry derives the unlock time as now + 52 weeks, a block-timestamp-dependent value.
The accumulated vested total is subtracted from totalEscrowedBalance, an arithmetic mutation of escrow accounting.
_appendVestingEntry adds quantity to totalEscrowedBalance before checking contract balance.
appendVestingEntry delegates to _appendVestingEntry after the onlyFeePool check.
distributeRewards performs an unchecked low-level call to each destination inside the distribution loop after transferring tokens.
msg.sender is compared with authority before the loop, and the ignored-return low-level call is reached only through that check.
appendVestingEntry relies on the onlyFeePool modifier comparing msg.sender to the feePool address.
updateAccessControl is onlyOwner-gated, and msg.sender is also the account whose rights are read in suspend/resume checks.

normalization_plan.reason: The abi-encoded payload is a transient local inside returnOwnership and should be folded into that function.
The success flag exists only to guard the arbitrary low-level call site and adds no separate semantics.
The parameter is used solely as the target of the risky low-level call, so it collapses into that unsafe_operation.
currentOwner is only compared against the stored owner inside migrate and should merge into that function node.
The running vested total is a loop-local accumulator in vest() and is fully absorbed by that function.
